test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
The hazards in coastal areas worsen due to the increase in which of the following?

a. Precipitation rate of the cyclone

b. Magnitude of storm

c. The rise of sea level

options.text: Only a and c are true
Only b and c are true
Only a and b are true
a, b and c all are true

solution:
The correct answer is **"a, b and c all are true"**
